intel_summary.summary: On Nov 25, 2026 an AI-led selloff briefly took the Nasdaq 100 down 20% from its October high, triggered by hot core PCE inflation and new tariff proposals; stocks then recovered most losses, with the S&P 500 closing -0.3% at 7,182.78 and the Dow +0.3%. NVIDIA fell 3.91% to $149.30; Amazon, Alphabet and Microsoft also declined. The US 10-year yield fell to ~4.86%, the dollar index eased ~0.12%, WTI rose ~3% to ~$85.22 after a Houthi refinery strike, gold rose ~0.5% to ~$3,574 and Bitcoin held near $59-60k. In the latest central bank round, the Fed and BoJ held rates while the BoE hiked 25bp to 4%. US markets are closed Nov 26 for Thanksgiving; next week brings Canadian GDP, Eurozone CPI, US ISM Manufacturing, Australian GDP and US ADP.
